AG-FACT-T2-W07-ROCK-CHARACTERISTICS (2026-11-09): characteristic blocks 443-448, 461-465 and 481-485 checked against USGS/NPS/BGS and introductory geology sources. Igneous rocks can form layered lava flows/layered intrusions (445); sedimentary rocks often but not always show bedding (461), may contain fossils (463), and can be erosion-resistant (464). Metamorphic foliation differs from sedimentary strata (481); fossils may rarely survive low-grade metamorphism (485). Other claims require qualified, material-dependent wording. AG-FACT-T2-W07-MICA-MCQ (2026-11-09): MCQ 505–506 compared with source examples 457–459 and USGS/BGS/ODNR classification. AG-FACT-T3-W01-EMASCULATOR (2026-11-09): block 45 wording checked against University of Kentucky Animal & Food Sciences Extension, UF College of Veterinary Medicine and ICAR-IVRI veterinary anatomy. AG-FACT-T3-W02-DRYING-POWER (2026-11-09): MCQ blocks 264-265 compared with FAO grain-drying guidance and a 2022 survey across five Ghanaian maize regions. Open sun drying predominates (Table 6 73.3-100% across five regions; solar dryer use 0-6.3%; mechanical 0%). AG-FACT-T3-W03-MECHANIZATION-DEFINITION (2026-11-09): block 289 compared with FAO 2013 Sub-Saharan Africa mechanization strategy and FAO 2006 farm-power report. Recommended a precise learner definition; no source correction applied.

AG-FACT-T3-W03-CROP-MECHANIZATION (2026-11-09): blocks 315 and 363 checked against FAO mechanization framework and IITA ProPAS cassava planter/harvester technology. AG-FACT-T3-W03-LABOUR-MCQ (2026-11-09): block 360 compared with source blocks 310 and 321-328 plus FAO 2006/2013 mechanization guidance. Bile emulsifies fats but is not an enzyme; 'chyle' at block 411 should be 'chyme'. Chymosin/rennin and salivary amylase require species/age qualification. Table 431 overgeneralizes fibre/bacterial digestion and protein synthesis; horses/rabbits are hindgut fermenters and all animals synthesize body proteins. AG-FACT-T3-W04-REPRODUCTIVE-ACCURACY (2026-11-09): blocks 482, 485, 486 and 492 compared with UMN CVM Large Animal Anatomy, Merck Vet Manual, Oregon State Extension, comparative veterinary anatomy and genetics glossaries. Cowper's/bulbourethral (male) and Bartholin's/greater vestibular (female) are homologous, distinct structures. Vagina length varies by species (cow 25–30cm; ewe 10–14cm; sow 10–15cm; mare 20–35cm). AG-FACT-T3-W05-RESPIRATION-ACCURACY (2026-11-09): blocks 532-541, 546, 552 and 597 compared with Monash/OpenStax, Merck Vet Manual, WA DPIRD and University of Hawai'i. Bronchioles branch from bronchi; epiglottis guards laryngeal inlet. Gill rakers filter food/particles; operculum covers/protects gills and assists water pumping in bony fish. Legal conclusion: the Act removes radical/absolute freehold title from private persons and vests it in the State Governor as trustee, but does not prevent individuals, families or communities from holding statutory or customary rights of occupancy.
